transcript: Speaker A: Paytm mein sabki mummy teacher se sawal pooch rahi thi English mein. Main chup baithi thi. Teacher ne meri taraf dekha aur bola, 'Any question?' Maine bola, 'No, ma'am.' Beta bagal mein baitha tha, woh samajh gaya. Mera naam Savitri hai. Main padhi-likhi nahi hoon, par apne bete ko maine best school mein dala, English medium. Sochi thi school padha dega, par PTM mein toh mujhe hi jana hai na? Teacher English mein bolti hai, 'Your child needs to improve in reading.' Mujhe samajh mein toh nahi aata, par main sar hila deti hoon. Doosri mummy poochti hain, 'Can you suggest some books on reading?' Mujhe bhi yahi poochhna hai, par English mein kaise bolu samajh mein hi nahi aata. Report card aata hai English mein, remarks aate hain English mein, grading system bhi English mein. A+ ka matlab pata hai, par 'needs to improve' ka matlab mujhe pooch ke jaana padta hai. Ek din beta bola, 'Mummy, agli PTM mein tum mat aana, papa ko bhej do.' Maine poocha, 'Kyun?' Chup ho gaya. Main samajh gayi, use sharm aati hai mujhse. Us raat phone pe English Seekho app mila. Sab samjhaya tha usme. Padhna nahi hai, sirf video dekhna hai aur sunna hai. 'General English' show kholo, 'Hello se baat shuru karein' yeh pehla video tha. Aise roz ke das easy sentences seekhe. 'My son is in class 3', 'He is a good student', 'He needs attention in reading'. Aise chhote-chhote sentences, par PTM ke liye kaafi. Good manners ke liye English words dekha, 'Thank you, ma'am', 'Excuse me', 'I understand', 'Could you please explain?'. Teacher ke saamne bolne ke liye itna kaafi. AI coach se practice ki, 24 ghante available. Bola, 'PTM hai kal, teacher se kya bolu?' AI coach ne sikha diya. Bolo, 'Ma'am, how is my son doing in class? Is there anything I can help at home? He sometimes finds reading difficult, can you suggest something?' 500 baar galat bola, usne 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi yeh nahi bola ki tum padhi-likhi nahi ho, tumse nahi hoga. Agli PTM mein gayi, teacher ne poocha, 'So Mrs. Savitri, any questions?' Maine bola, 'Yes, ma'am. How is Rohit doing in English? He tries to read at home but he struggles. Can you suggest some easy books for him?' Teacher ruki, smile kiya aur boli, 'That's a great question. I'll send a list home.' Beta paas mein baitha tha, woh meri taraf dekha, par is baar expression alag tha. Bola, 'Mummy, tum next PTM mein bhi aana.' English Seekho app download karo. 'General English' show kholo. 'Hello se baat shuru karein' se start karo. AI coach se practice karo. Apne bachhe ke liye seekho. Ek mahine mein PTM mein chup nahi baithogi. [At the PTM, everyone's mother was asking the teacher questions in English. I sat silently. The teacher looked at me and asked, 'Any question?' I said, 'No, ma'am.' My son sitting next to me understood. My name is Savitri. I am not educated, but I put my son in the best English medium school. I thought the school would teach him, but I have to go to the PTM, right? The teacher speaks in English, 'Your child needs to improve in reading.' I don't understand, but I just nod. Another mother asks, 'Can you suggest some books on reading?' I want to ask the same, but I don't know how to say it in English. The report card is in English, remarks are in English, even the grading system is in English. I know what A+ means, but I have to ask someone to understand 'needs to improve'. One day my son said, 'Mummy, don't come to the next PTM, send Papa.' I asked, 'Why?' He went quiet. I understood, he is ashamed of me. That night I found the English Seekho app on my phone. Everything was explained in it. You don't have to read, just watch videos and listen. Open the 'General English' show, 'Start talking with Hello' was the first video. I learned ten easy sentences daily like this. 'My son is in class 3', 'He is a good student', 'He needs attention in reading'. Small sentences like these, but enough for PTM. I looked up English words for good manners, 'Thank you, ma'am', 'Excuse me', 'I understand', 'Could you please explain?'. This is enough to speak in front of the teacher. I practiced with the AI coach, available 24 hours. I said, 'I have a PTM tomorrow, what should I say to the teacher?' The AI coach taught me. Say, 'Ma'am, how is my son doing in class? Is there anything I can help at home? He sometimes finds reading difficult, can you suggest something?' I spoke incorrectly 500 times, and it corrected me 500 times. It never said you are uneducated, you can't do it. I went to the next PTM, the teacher asked, 'So Mrs. Savitri, any questions?' I said, 'Yes, ma'am. How is Rohit doing in English? He tries to read at home but he struggles. Can you suggest some easy books for him?' The teacher paused, smiled, and said, 'That's a great question. I'll send a list home.' My son was sitting nearby, he looked at me, but this time his expression was different. He said, 'Mummy, you must come to the next PTM too.' Download the English Seekho app. Open the 'General English' show. Start with 'Start talking with Hello'. Practice with the AI coach. Learn for your child. In one month, you won't sit silent in PTMs.] Speaker B: Install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A mother shares her emotional journey of feeling embarrassed at her son's English-medium school parent-teacher meetings because she cannot speak English. After her son asks her not to attend the next meeting, she downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily sentences, and successfully communicates with the teacher at the next PTM. The ad encourages parents to download the app to learn English for their children's sake.
